/.title: Solarity AI: AI-powered self-improvement apps and web apps
/.description: Solarity AI builds AI self-improvement apps for iOS and Android, Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max, and three web apps for building mobile products.

/apps.title: AI self-improvement apps for iOS and Android
/apps.description: Discover Looks Max, IQ Max, Sleep Max, and Fitness Max, and the Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max web apps from Solarity AI.

/apps/looks-max.title: Looks Max: AI face analysis and self-care app
/apps/looks-max.description: Looks Max is an AI appearance and self-care app for iOS and Android: AI facial assessments, personalized grooming suggestions, and a progress journal.

/apps/iq-max.title: IQ Max: daily cognitive exercises app
/apps/iq-max.description: IQ Max is a cognitive practice app for iOS and Android: daily exercises for memory, reaction time, and attention, with adaptive difficulty, stars, and streaks.

/apps/sleep-max.title: Sleep Max: sleep diary and AI sleep coach app
/apps/sleep-max.description: Sleep Max is a sleep app for iOS and Android: a sleep diary with an app-generated Sleep Score, habit tracking, soundscapes, and an AI sleep coach.

/apps/fitness-max.title: Fitness Max: AI fitness and nutrition coach
/apps/fitness-max.description: Fitness Max, listed in the app stores as Only Fitness, is an AI fitness and nutrition app: photo meal analysis, voice or text logging, and AI coaching.

/platform.title: Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max
/platform.description: Engineering Max, Management Max, and Marketing Max: three Solarity AI web apps for engineering, managing, and marketing mobile products.

/company.description: Solarity AI LLC was founded by Ata Turhan in Irving, Texas. Meet the founder and the team building self-improvement apps and web apps for mobile products.

/careers.description: Fully remote engineering, marketing, and business development roles at Solarity AI, with profit sharing. Apply to help build focused AI-powered mobile products.
